questions.question: Show the number of accounts for all accounts by the customer with first name 'Meaghan' opened in each day. Bin the account open day by weekday in a bar chart.
questions.sql: SELECT strftime('%w', date_account_opened) as weekday, COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Customers WHERE customer_first_name = 'Meaghan') GROUP BY strftime('%w', date_account_opened) ORDER BY weekday;
